items.title: U.S. convicts ex-Google engineer for sending AI tech data to China
items.description: A U.S. federal jury has convicted Linwei Ding, a former software engineer at Google, for stealing AI supercomputer data from his employer and secretly sharing it with Chinese tech firms. [...]

items.title: Cloud storage payment scam floods inboxes with fake renewals
items.description: Over the past few months, a large-scale cloud storage subscription scam campaign has been targeting users worldwide with repeated emails falsely warning recipients that their photos, files, and accounts are about to be blocked or deleted due to an alleged payment failure. [...]

items.title: Torq Moves SOCs Beyond SOAR With AI-Powered Hyper Automation
items.description: Investors poured $140 million into Torq's Series D Round, bringing the startup's valuation to $1.2 billion, to bring AI-based "hyper automation" to SOCs.
